sentences.text: Shartegosuchus is a genus of crocodyliform belonging to the protosuchian grade.
This animal belongs to the class Sauropsida, the suborder Protosuchia, and the superorder Crocodylomorpha.
The genus is known mainly from specimen PIN 4174/2, which consists of a partially deformed skull and jaws of a juvenile.

Mikhail Efimov described the genus in 1988, with S. asperopalatum designated as the type species. The animal lived between 149.2 and 143.1 million years ago during the Tithonian stage in ancient lake deposits of the Upper Jurassic Ulan Malgait Formation in southwestern Mongolia.
Shartegosuchus is the type genus of the family Shartegosuchidae, a group that also includes the similar genus Nominosuchus.
